title: I had the rare chance to peek behind the curtain at @Maybe Happy Endi...
transcript: Is about to go down. Today is the first day of tech for maybe happy ending, a new musical coming to Broadway. And I get to go. For the past few weeks, maybe happy ending has been working on the show in a rehearsal space, but today they are meeting their crew, and they are moving into their theater. This is where the real work of putting on a Broadway show begins. The first day is really exciting. It feels kind of like First Day of school. And it was extra special because so many people are making their Broadway debuts in the show. This is truly a dream come true. I am overwhelmed. I'm so excited for the show to kind of be put together. And to start the day, they do a classic theater. Kids circle up. Can you come in so we can see each other's faces? Welcome to the first day of. We'll just pass this mic around. Then every single member of the cast and the crew introduces themselves and says what they do on the show. Every single person in this room is an expert in what they do. And never be afraid to raise your hand, raise your voice if you have an idea for something. No matter what we dream it can be, it's going to be something so much bigger, so much more complex, so much more collaborative. Maybe happy endings first preview is October 16th, which means that this cast and Crew has less than two weeks to bring maybe happy ending to life. And I for one, can't wait to see it.
classificationReason: Behind-the-scenes content about the first day of tech rehearsals, not a review of the actual production - creator hasn't seen the show yet
